title: Keep up with global e-invoicing mandates.
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
## Brückner is automating 70% of invoices in one business unit.


“Vertex’s professional and collaborative approach convinced us that they are the right partner for our e-invoicing transformation.”


– Josef Wieser, Manager Indirect Tax Technology, Brückner Group


## TeamViewer powers global e-invoicing compliance.


“We chose Vertex e-Invoicing because of its extensive global market coverage and its ability to seamlessly integrate with our existing systems. By consolidating our global e-invoicing processes in one solution, we can ensure compliance with diverse regulatory requirements now and in the future, which is crucial to our global operations.”


- Simon Grosser, Business Operations Manager at TeamViewer
